title: DualReadArtifact
description: Portable artifact that is both human-readable and machine-readable. Human sees form; system sees state. Survives offline.

format.description: How the dual layers are packaged

humanForm.description: Narrative, visual, or structured text intended for human eyes

machineState.description: Canonical state, deltas, and links for the system

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the combined human + machine payload for integrity

receiptId.description: Optional link back to the MutationReceipt that produced this artifact
